objective: sum over unordered reactant atom pairs abs(reactant bond order - mapped product bond order); missing bond=0
formal_charge_and_H: preserve and report before/after, not hard match invariants; only heavy atoms mapped
tie_policy: stable main mapping; if another equal-cost mapping exists retain one alternate and mark ambiguous
component_identity: side + 0-based molecule index; atom index 0-based within molecule
